entities.summary: Stanislav Horuna (b. 1989-03-01, Lviv) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Lviv and Ukraine. Known in the fields of ukraine, architects & designers, europe.
